items.title: Pay invoice for hearing aids (personal share)
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Private payment deadline, counted under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB. Start event: invoice date 19.11.2026 (Thursday) - this day is not counted. Counting 30 days from 20.11.2026 (day 1) gives day 30 = 19.12.2026 (Saturday). Since the payment is owed to a company (payee's/payer's own Land, here NW per person's residence), § 193 BGB applies: a Saturday end-date moves to the next working day. No public holiday falls on 20 or 21 December 2026 in NW, so the due date moves to Monday 21.12.2026.

warnings: The letter offers installment payment ('Ratenzahlung ist nach Absprache möglich') after contacting the provider directly – confirm any payment plan in writing before relying on it.

Double-check the IBAN/BIC printed on the invoice (DE36 3705 0198 0005 5277 00, Musterbank AG) against previous correspondence from this provider before transferring money, as a precaution against fraudulent invoices.
